title: 4 · Feedback or new idea → controlled update
summary: Attach feedback to exact output/revision and affected node; preserve the paused task.
body:
Attach feedback to exact output/revision and affected node; preserve the paused task.

Inspect evidence, selection, writer input and judgments. Diagnose the earliest demonstrated failure.

Change the smallest relevant record/module; inspect linked dependencies and actual interfaces for downstream effects.

Explain consequential cross-component changes before expanding scope. Do not quietly rewrite unrelated checkpoints.

Replay the affected example, compare before/after, protect previously acceptable examples.

Repeated failure stops the same repair path; bring the evidence back for a design decision, without a required model brand.
